messages:
carol_support: FYI customer 'BlueHarbor' hit a hard escalation. After we rotated their KMS key alias this morning some tenants started getting HTTP 403 from our decrypt proxy and their app retried a ton -> billing spike. CloudTrail shows the ReEncrypt/Decrypt on the KMS key, but for several requests we have no matching PutObject/audit entries in our app logs.
ben_oncall: pinging logs now. do we have a repro trace or request id from the tenant?
carol_support: they provided request id `req-0a1b2c3d` and a snippet of client stack: "KMS.DecryptAccessDeniedException: encryption metadata mismatch". They also pasted an app request with header `X-RWD-KMS-META: <redacted>` missing on retries.
dave_infra: interesting. we rolled the alias earlier during the maintenance window. could be a timing window where proxy or STS sessions still had old session policies that strip forwarded metadata. 
alice_security: @dave_infra do we still have the proxy change that removes unknown headers for assumed-role sessions? I remember a hardening commit that stripped custom headers unless session tags included `allow_metadata_forward=true`.
dave_infra: yes that commit landed last month. session policy evaluation uses session tags to permit `X-RWD-KMS-META`. If an STS assume-role flow doesn't pass the tag, proxy drops the header which causes encryption-context mismatch at decrypt time.
eve_engineer: i repro'd locally by assuming the tenant role without the tag:
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/tenant-proxy --role-session-name t1 --duration-seconds 3600
# note: no --tags provided
curl -H "X-RWD-KMS-META: tenant=blueharbor" https://proxy.internal/decrypt
# response: 403 DecryptAccessDeniedException
```
carol_support: customer says their SDK toggles session tagging off in some environments. they'd never hit this before because alias swap was atomic, but rotation + proxy change exposed it.
ben_oncall: ok mitigation steps? rollback alias swap or patch proxy to accept metadata until tags are restored?
dave_infra: short term: enable a relaxed header passthrough for the alias we rotated OR add a temporary session policy exception for that tenant role. both are risky. rollback alias can restore old key material but may cause other issues.
alice_security: recommended path: 1) add a short lived exception to the proxy to preserve `X-RWD-KMS-META` for requests originating from tenant-role ARNs. 2) patch client onboarding doc to ensure assume-role calls include `--tags Key=allow_metadata_forward,Value=true` or equivalent. 3) schedule a postmortem and review the alias cutover playbook to ensure header propagation during key rotation.
eve_engineer: i've drafted a quick proxy patch and smoke tests. will push to canary in staging now. patch toggles header forwarding when `x-rwd-tenant-role` header matches allowlist.
ben_oncall: thanks, please add logs that capture when header is dropped and include the STS session tags in the debug log. that'll help us find any other tenants.
dave_infra: rolling the proxy patch to canary (deploy-bot: deploy started).
kms-proxy-bot: canary deploy completed for proxy v2.14.1-canary at 1777777812. health: OK.
eve_engineer: canary smoke looks good, decrypts now succeed when client doesn't pass tags, and no 403 in the trace. adding a follow-up task to add automated test in the assume-role pipeline.
carol_support: I told BlueHarbor we're applying a hotfix and to keep retries off for 15m. they're down ~8% traffic but stable. they asked for root cause writeup.
alice_security: assign postmortem to eng-security + eng-infra + support. include findings: header hardening + alias swap race + clients without sts tags = decrypt failures + retry storm -> billing spike. recommend: docs + onboarding + safe-guarded proxy behavior + canary cutover for future key rotations.
ben_oncall: closing the urgent loop. will keep monitoring billing and CloudTrail correlations. if anyone finds other tenants with dropped headers ping here. :thumbsup:
